messages:
Maria (Sales): Hey team — ACME wants to close the POC this week. They still have pricing questions, a security questionnaire to finish, and legal wants MSA/DPA redlines reviewed. Need signature routing plan for PO + eSign. Can we triage?
Devon (Solutions): Quick Qs: which model/config are we promising for the POC (throughput / region)? I need to confirm the rate card to answer pricing.
Maria (Sales): POC scope: 3k daily tokens, hosted API in us-west, can bump to dedicated if they commit. Current quote: $5k/month hosted + $3k one-time onboarding.
Devon (Solutions): Ok; I can confirm throughput. Tagging @ops-bot for capacity note.
ops-bot: FYI: us-west capacity looks fine for a 3k/day POC. No dedicated GPUs required for <10k/day.
Priya (Legal): I reviewed their MSA redlines. Two narrow asks: 1) Limit indemnity carveout to third-party IP claims only; 2) Add specific DPA subprocessing list. I can propose language.
Maria (Sales): Can you paste the proposed clause edits? ACME legal is pushing for broader liability limits.
Priya (Legal): Proposed edits (short):
```
- Liability cap: "Company's aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid in the prior 12 months."
- Indemnity: "Indemnitor will only indemnify for third-party IP infringement directly arising from the services."
- DPA: "Subprocessors list to be provided; customer data residency will remain in US unless agreed otherwise."
```
Priya (Legal): If they insist on unlimited liability, escalate to execs. Otherwise we can accept these redlines.
Liam (Finance): Net terms? Quote assumes Net 30. ACME procurement asked Net 45. We can do Net 45 for enterprise deals but need exec approval for discount shift. Also need PO number for provisioning.
Maria (Sales): They said PO will be raised once MSA is signed. Can we route signatures through DocuSign with two signers: ACME legal + ACME finance, then our Sales exec?
Priya (Legal): DocuSign is fine. We require the countersign to include the MSA attachment hash and the executed DPA. Suggest workflow: ACME signs -> our Legal signs -> Sales finalizes PO.
Devon (Solutions): For the security questionnaire, they sent an SSP + SIG-lite. I filled most items about runtime, encryption at rest (AES-256), KMS integration, and logging retention. Leaving backlog items: SOC2 cert copy and network diagram.
Maria (Sales): Can you drop the SOC2 link and diagram into the thread? I'll push to ACME.
Devon (Solutions): SOC2 PDF: https://redwood-internal/soc2/2025-report.pdf (internal link). Network diagram uploaded to confluence: https://confluence/redwood/poc-arch-acme
Maria (Sales): Good. ACME also asked for mandatory EU data residency for a subset of customers — they want DPA annotation on that. Priya, is partial residency ok?
Priya (Legal): We can add a DPA appendix referencing regional controls and an option to deploy to eu-central for the subset, but that moves them to Dedicated/private and affects pricing. Add a note in the SOW.
Liam (Finance): If they require EU region for part of traffic, add $2k/month delta on the quote for cross-region costs and support. Approve this with ACME finance.
Maria (Sales): Action items summary:
- Priya: prepare redline MSA + DPA appendix with subprocessor list and regional clause.
- Devon: attach SOC2 & network diagram answers to the security questionnaire; mark open items.
- Liam: confirm Net45 impact to billing and update quote (+ any EU region delta).
- Maria: prepare DocuSign envelope with MSA + DPA + Order Form, routing: ACME Legal -> ACME Finance -> Redwood Legal (Priya) -> Sales Exec (Maria).
Priya (Legal): Sounds good. Please include a signature block for Redwood's Data Processing Addendum and the subprocessor reference by name.
Maria (Sales): Will do. Target timeline: get signatures and PO by EOD Friday. ACME is expecting a go/no-go then.
Devon (Solutions): I'll mark capacity as reserved once PO arrives.
Liam (Finance): Please ping me when DocuSign sent so I can watch for invoice trigger.
Maria (Sales): Thanks all — I’ll assemble the envelope and post the draft redline in ~2 hours. @Priya @Liam @Devon please review asap. :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): On it.
Liam (Finance): On it.
Devon (Solutions): Reviewing now.
